body:
Web invite flow (Members -> email -> Invite) mints an invite but discards the
returned url, so the inviter never gets a link to send. Surface the invite URL
after minting with a copy-to-clipboard control (the Android app already shares the
URL via a share intent). Only freshly-minted invites can show it — the members
response doesn't carry tokens for pre-existing pending invites.
title: Web: expose the invite link/token after minting so the inviter can share it
